acceptance.given: A sandbox write request is supplied to an isolated sandbox-fixture fixture while all other inputs remain constant.

oracle.expected: The fixture emits a boundary artifact recording rejection of the sandbox write and an independent witness.
forbidden: Other inputs change during the fixture run.
Rejection is claimed without a boundary artifact.
oracle.observable: The sandbox-fixture result and boundary artifact show the write was rejected; the input manifest confirms only the sandbox write request differs.

acceptance.then: The sandbox write is rejected and the isolated fixture records the rejection with an independent witness.
acceptance.when: Run the isolated sandbox-fixture fixture and inspect its boundary artifact during verification.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run the isolated sandbox-fixture fixture; fail if it is missing, mutates unrelated inputs, accepts the write, or emits no rejection artifact.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Enforce and evidence rejection of writes targeting the sandbox boundary.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve the governance-policy schema and denial semantics; rollback restores the prior policy implementation.

slice_hint.state_transition: sandbox write requested -> governance boundary evaluation -> write rejected with artifact
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The fixture records a rejected sandbox write, unchanged controls, and an independent witness artifact.

acceptance.given: The required validator is absent in an isolated missing-validator fixture while all other inputs remain constant.

oracle.expected: Validator identity evaluation records identity-invalid and withholds any trusted Replay Result.
forbidden: The missing validator is accepted as valid.
A trusted Replay Result is produced from the missing-validator condition.
oracle.observable: The fixture artifact contains identity-invalid, no trusted Replay Result, and an input manifest showing only validator absence changed.

acceptance.then: The validator is classified identity-invalid and trusted replay output is withheld.
acceptance.when: Run the isolated missing-validator fixture and inspect identity classification and replay-result fields.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Select the missing-validator fixture; fail when classification is not identity-invalid or when a trusted Replay Result is emitted.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Classify an absent required validator as identity-invalid and prevent trusted replay output.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Retain validator identity and Replay Result schemas; rollback restores prior classification behavior.

slice_hint.state_transition: validator absent -> identity validation -> identity-invalid; trusted replay result suppressed
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The fixture records identity-invalid, no trusted Replay Result, and unchanged non-validator inputs.

acceptance.given: An isolated policy-removal fixture removes only VDD or Acceptance while all other inputs remain constant.

oracle.expected: Minimum-set evaluation rejects the policy reduction and records an independently verifiable witness.

acceptance.then: Policy-reduction rejection is covered by the isolated fixture with an independent witness.
acceptance.when: Run the isolated policy-removal fixture and inspect rejection and witness artifacts during governance verification.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run the isolated policy-removal fixture; fail if unrelated inputs change, reduction is accepted, or no independent witness artifact is produced.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Verify minimum-set enforcement for isolated VDD/Acceptance removal and require an independent witness.
